name: hallucinated-total-guard
description: The data collection logs a $600 total but the shop only ever said $1,600. The pipeline must refuse to confirm the total against the transcript and flag the missing evidence.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Parts are $900, labor is $560, shop supplies $60, diagnostic and disposal are $0, and tax is $80.
Thank you. Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds.
With everything, you're looking at $1,600. Warranty 12 months. Earliest Monday, good for 7 days.
Understood. I'll present those terms to the customer.
